rationale: This document is unusually transparent about licensing: it explicitly frames all contributions as licenses (CC BY-SA, GFDL), never disguises ownership as purchase, and clearly states users never own their content. However, termination without cause/notice is severe, and legal vocabulary combined with length moderately burdens ordinary readers. The absence of arbitration and class-action waivers is notably user-friendly compared to commercial platforms.
